message_text: I clicked on the housing application link in my acceptance email and it goes to a 404 page
I apologize for the broken link. The housing portal recently moved. The correct URL is university.edu/housing/apply.
How long has this been broken? I bet other students are having the same issue.
Thank you for reporting this. I'll escalate it to our web team immediately to get the link updated in the acceptance email template.
ok. The new link works at least. When is the housing deposit deadline?
The housing deposit of $200 is due by May 1st. Room selection begins May 15th based on deposit date.
